description: The pie chart, labeled "(a) Video type distribution," represents the distribution of videos across various categories. The chart is divided into 14 slices, each representing a different category, including People Blogs (orange, 17.2%), Howto Style (green, 9.7%), Education (red, 8.7%), Entertainment (purple, 13.9%), Film Animation (dark purple, 4.6%), Music (pink, 2.3%), Autos Vehicles (light blue, 4.8%), Sports (blue, 6.4%), Pets Animals (light pink, 4.6%), News Politics (light green, 5.6%), Travel Events (beige, 3.9%), Gaming (lavender, 7.7%), Science Technology (gray, 6.4%), and Comedy (brown, 4.3%). The percentage labels are shown inside each slice, and the chart does not include a legend. The slices are arranged in a somewhat ordered manner, with the largest slice, People Blogs, positioned at the top right, and the remaining slices distributed around the chart in a clockwise direction.
